mapper.sql: bbs33_role_id AS role_id , bbs33_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , bbs33_role_cd AS role_cd , bbs33_person_id AS person_id , bbs33_org_code_id AS org_code_id , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs33_person_id) AS person_name , CASE WHEN bbs33_role_cd = 'P' THEN f_get_empTrans(bbs33_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') ELSE f_org_parent_full_nm(bbs33_org_code_id, f_sysdate()) END AS org_name , CASE WHEN bbs33_role_cd = 'P' THEN '사원' ELSE '부서' END AS role_name
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs33_role WHERE 1=1 AND bbs33_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND ( (bbs33_role_cd = 'P' AND bbs33_person_id = #{personId}) OR (bbs33_role_cd = 'O' AND bbs33_org_code_id = #{orgId}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs33_role (bbs33_role_id, bbs33_class_tree_id, bbs33_role_cd, bbs33_person_id, bbs33_org_code_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{classTreeId}, #{r.roleCd}, #{r.personId}, #{r.orgCodeId})
